text:
kai: Heads up — noticed a cluster of GPUs in eu-west with repeated Xid 63 bursts over the last 48h. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/GPUs/gpu-telemetry?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west

marta: can you paste the query you used? trying to reproduce the spike in the global view

kai: PromQL I ran: `sum by(card_id)(increase(nvidia_xid_errors_total{region="eu-west"}[48h]))` then EWMA over 6h to find decay patterns. Example: `ewma(1h, sum by(card_id)(increase(nvidia_xid_errors_total[1h])))`

anjali: Nice. What threshold are we treating as "decay" vs normal flake?

kai: proposal: decay_score = 0.7*EWMA(errors) + 0.3*recent_spike_count(normalized). Flag if decay_score > 5 for 24h. Rationale: picks up cards that trend worse instead of single bursts.

lee: +1 for EWMA. Need per-region baselines though — eu-west has older cards and higher ambient Xid. We should z-score relative to region baseline before thresholding.

jordan: Agree. Also add an availability penalty if card has >2 drains in 30d. That should raise priority for replacement.

marta: UI request for Console: can we surface three things on GPU detail — decay_score, last_xid_ts, drain_count? Want a small red/yellow/green flag on the host row.

ops-bot: incident: gpu-card-evict triggered on host i-0a1b2c in eu-west at 1951234502 — auto-evict policy applied (reason: Xid bursts)

anjali: For the Drain Prioritization queue, sorting key proposal: (1) decay_score, (2) drain_count, (3) region_criticality, (4) age_days. region_criticality is a tag we set per service SLA.

kai: Cost angle — draining+replacing too aggressively increases spare capacity usage. Suggest we compute expected cost delta: replacement_cost = spot_replace_hours * hourly_gpu_rate + sla_penalty_estimate. Only escalate to hardware replacement if decay_score > 12 or drain_count >=3. Otherwise schedule maintenance (check connections, reflash firmware) during next window.

lee: Operational note — firmware reflash reduced Xid bursts for older A100 hosts in staging last month. Add runbook step: `reflash-driver && run nvidia-smi -q` and monitor errors for 4h before scheduling replacement.

marta: Grafana panels to add: 1) per-card EWMA trend with region baseline overlay, 2) decay_score histogram by rack, 3) drain-priority queue heatmap. I can mock panels.

jordan: Can we emit a metric `gpu_decay_score{card_id,region}` so Alertmanager can fire on sustained >10 for 6h? Also create a lower-severity alert >5 for 24h to ping infra-runbook channel.

anjali: +1. Add suppressions for canary hosts and for maintenance windows.

kai: I'll draft PR for the alert rules and add the decay_score exporter as a small service that reads exporter metrics and computes EWMA. ETA: PR by EOD tomorrow.

marta: I'll mock the dashboard tiles and push to the staging grafana folder.

lee: Can we also include a cost estimate panel per region showing projected spare usage if we enforce replacement threshold X? Helps lead time decisions.

kai: Good call. I'll include a simple spreadsheet calc and expose as a CSV endpoint for the dashboard to pull.

ops-bot: note: scheduled maintenance window for eu-west: 1951250000-1951260000 (UTC)

jordan: Action items: kai -> exporter + alert PR, marta -> dashboard tiles, lee -> collect historical region baselines, anjali -> update runbook with reflash + replacement thresholds.

marta: ping me if you want product to review UI flags before dev.

kai: thanks all — we'll iterate. Closing the thread but will post PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
